author: /root/transport_fallback
judgment: The isolated one-local and one-real-C++ subscriber fixture waits for two Vector3d descriptors before publishing. It verifies exactly ten ordered local Vector3d values x=0..9, y=z=0 within the original five-second receipt bound, then rejects an extra local copy over the native 300 ms quiet period. The native original was replayed 1/0 with no skips; production and API are unchanged.
limits: PARTIAL original port: two public type descriptors are a fixture-specific surrogate for two distinct native process UUIDs; process identities are not exposed.
The C++ peer only registers its subscription; neither the original nor this port asserts its delivered payloads.
The exact 5 s outer limit of native settledValue after the last local delivery is not separately exercised; the Rust channel's 300 ms timeout checks the decisive quiet interval.
No general delivery guarantee, complete original retirement, normal hook, publication, or hosted qualification is implied.

private_review.source: Raw public base Git archive plus exact staged tests/interop.rs exported to a separate /tmp tree; exclusive Cargo target and all bound tracked hashes verified.
private_review.selected_positive: With network-interface access and the unchanged hashed C++ peer, private selected test passed 1/0 in 0.36 s.
private_review.negative: In separate private source, changing only the publish loop from ten to eleven causes the exact extra-local-copy assertion to fail with an eleventh Vector3d message.
private_review.setup_failure: First private run in restricted socket sandbox failed before READY with socket creation errors; excluded from positive evidence.

scope: Test-only bounded local-once assertion port of pinned twoProcPubSub.LocalSubscriberReceivesOnceWithRemoteSubscriber.
